_comment: Settings for the work queue. Installed as queue.config.json in the project root. Missing fields get the defaults in scripts/orchestrator/lib/queueConfig.js. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_mode: "mode": "lite" = the core loop only (add with just a title, no classes, value or batch queue to learn); "full" = every feature. Without the key the mode is full, but a fresh `ravenseat init` writes lite (`ravenseat init --full` to opt out). Switch any time with `ravenseat mode lite|full`.
_gateEvidence: Whose gate evidence receive and merge rely on. own (default): they run the quick gates themselves (reusing their own earlier green run on the same tip and gate setup; a track's own run in its worktree is never reused) and check your answers, edits and approvals in queue.json against the owner log. external: also a green run of the GitHub checks named in external on exactly the same commit counts as the full gate (read with gh). off: they take the track's gates=OK and do not check owner rows. external [] = no check counts. external and off weaken a guard.
_gates: Shell commands the tracks run before delivery (gates.mjs --quick / --full). Empty lists = no gates. precheck (gates.mjs --precheck) runs first and stops at the first red check; null = the standard checks, or a list where {changed} = the changed files and {file} = once per file.
_timeoutSec: gates.timeoutSec (default null = baseGate.timeoutSec, 900 s): the time budget for the whole list when a track runs its own gates (ravenseat gates --quick or --full in its worktree, without --timeout-sec). A gate over it is red. 0 = no budget. receive and merge pass baseGate.timeoutSec themselves; the main checkout has no budget unless one is passed.
_flakyRerun: gates.flakyRerun (default true): a red quick or full gate run in a track's worktree runs only its red commands once more on the same commit (never on a dirty tree, never in the main checkout, which the base gate's baseGate.flakyRerun covers). Green then is green with flaky (a flakyGate time log row, and at receive a finding and a section in the review package); red twice is red. false = no rerun.
_redOnBase: gates.redOnBase: receive runs the track's new or changed test files on the tip (must pass) and with the rest of its change taken away (at least one must fail), then puts the worktree back. A warning, never a stop. A command with {files} where the quoted files go, e.g. "npx vitest run {files}", or { command, timeoutSec, maxFiles }. null = off.
_doneCheck: The done command (task field done_when): receive and merge run it in the track's worktree; exit != 0 gives a fix round instead of review or merge. timeoutSec = time budget per run; tailLines = the last output lines kept for the fix brief (only the tail is kept). maxFixRounds = fix rounds per task before it becomes an owner question (task field max_fix_rounds overrides). fixPlateau (default true): before a fix round the owner is asked when the previous fix round committed nothing or the check fails the same way as before it; false = only the cap.
_fixRound: A fix round as a continuation: resume --reason fix tells the orchestrator to send the fix list to the agent that delivered (SendMessage) when it stopped at most continueWithinMin minutes ago (0 = always a new agent) and had at most continueMaxContextK thousand tokens of context (0 = no cap). Otherwise a new agent with a short fix mission.
_reads: Read ownership (task field reads: files or folders with / that the task builds on but does not change). mode wait (default): a task that reads a file an active task changes waits until that task is done, and so does a task that would change a file an active task reads. mode warn: it starts anyway, and start, fill, explain and the mission name the overlap. Two readers never block each other.
_claudeFingerprint: Fingerprint of your own Claude setup (~/.claude, or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR): start records hashes of the settings files, keybindings, CLAUDE.md, the plugin manifests and the agents, commands, skills and hooks folders; receive warns with CLAUDE SETUP CHANGED when one changed while the track ran (git does not see that folder). Only hashes are stored, never content. false = off.
_agentGuard: The push, network and write guards apply to every subagent, not only the queue's own agent types; read-only commands stay allowed and the main session is never guarded. except: agent types to leave alone. enabled false: only the queue's own types. Both weaken a guard.
_agentPushBlock: A git pre-push hook that stops a push from a track worktree, also one the push guard never saw. fill, start and resume install it after the first line of an existing shell pre-push; the main checkout is not affected. false = removed at the next fill, start or resume (weakens a guard).
_ownership: sharedPatchCollides: a path in a task's shared_patch collides with another active task's owned_files, at start (the second task waits) and at merge (the ownership stop). false = shared_patch is compared only with shared_patch, as before (weakens a guard; full task format only).
_wiring: stop: each WIRE <file> | <what> line in a track's report becomes an open item on the task (receive), and set done and the done step of merge refuse while one is open; ravenseat wiring <id> <item> --commit <sha> or --reject "<reason>" closes it. false = done passes with open items and says so (weakens a guard).
_baseGate: The base gate: after ravenseat merge the base branch's new tip is checked in the main checkout and the verdict recorded per tip (scripts/.queue/base-health.json). While it is red, ravenseat merge refuses other tracks (exit 9; --force-red-base overrides, logged) and a fix task <id>-BASE<n> is added. enabled: auto (on when there are commands), true or false. commands: null = the quick gates (the merge step's own gates run is the check), or a list run after them. timeoutSec = budget for the whole list; tailLines null = doneCheck.tailLines. flakyRerun (default true): a red check first reruns only the failed commands once on the same sha; green then is recorded as flaky (a finding, no freeze), red twice freezes.
_wait: The wait mode for long calls: ravenseat gates, receive and merge block for at most wait.blockSec seconds (default 280, under the 5 minute prompt cache; at most 590). A run not done by then goes on detached, and the call prints one RUNNING line with the next command (<command> --wait <id>) and the Bash timeout for it, exit 75. The same command on the same commit is never started twice while one runs. 0 = off (the call blocks until done). A terminal and QUEUE_WAIT=off also block as before.
_inspection: The inspection queue (ravenseat inspection): the same failure, from the gates or CI, in at least minRepeats incidents (tasks, or a branch and a day, or CI commits) within windowDays days becomes one proposal to build a guard; you approve, reject or snooze it. mode on or off. registryFile = the tracked guard registry (ravenseat guards).
_gateQueue: The queue for heavy gates: gates.mjs --quick/--full waits for one of slots slots shared by the whole machine (across worktrees and projects) when its last run of the same kind took at least heavyAfterSec seconds. Waiters are served base runs first (the main checkout), then receive runs, then a track's own runs, and first come, first served within a class; one that has waited agingMin minutes counts as base. No history counts as light, so small projects never notice it. The time budget starts when the check starts; the wait goes into the time log as wait_sec. enabled false turns it off.
_gateTemp: A temp folder of its own for each gate run: the gate commands get it through TEMP, TMP and TMPDIR, and it is removed when the run ends, so what a project's tests leave goes with it. A folder holding a link is left in place. enabled false gives the commands the normal temp folder.
_usageLimit: The pause at the subscription's usage limit: the StopFailure hook saves the reset time, and no new tracks or fix rounds start until then (exit 12). Running tracks are left alone. pause false turns it off; ravenseat limit usageLimit clear lifts one pause.
_push: The batch push threshold, counted in merged tasks (ravenseat merge) not yet on <remote>/<baseBranch>. mode: owner (push only on the owner's word) or threshold (the orchestrator may push when ravenseat push-check says READY or LARGE, never BLOCKED). minTasks: READY from this many (0 = no lower limit); below it, or on a red base, the push guard asks before a plain push of the base branch (never denies). warnTasks: LARGE from this many (push recommended; 0 = off). maxAgeHours: null, or unpushed work older than this makes the batch READY below minTasks. ciWatch: off, or github for the optional CI watch after a batch push (ravenseat push-check --watch-ci <sha> in the background, needs gh): a failed check gives the fix task CI-<sha7> and a red base, an infrastructure failure an owner question; polled every ciWatchIntervalSec, given up after ciWatchTimeoutMin.
_productionBranch: The branch that goes live (null = unknown). ravenseat doctor warns when it equals baseBranch: every batch push would then go to production.
_deployCommands: Commands that deploy; the push guard asks before any command that starts with one of them (agents and the main session). Empty = off. Examples: ["vercel --prod", "fly deploy", "firebase deploy", "npm run deploy"].
_secretScan: Before a plain push of baseBranch from the main session, the added lines of what is pushed are scanned for secrets (gitleaks when on PATH, else a few built-in patterns); a hit asks with file:line, never the value. A diff over maxBytes is not scanned, and the push asks; timeoutMs per git or gitleaks call. An internal error in the hook lets the push through.
_largeFileMb: ravenseat doctor warns about tracked files larger than this (MB).
_instructionSize: Advice when the instructions Claude Code loads in every session, track and subagent grow: an always-loaded file over maxLines lines (200, the Claude Code docs) or the whole set over maxChars characters (40,000, where Claude Code itself warns). mode off turns it off; it is advice, not a guard. ravenseat instructions shows the set and proposes a split.
_migrations: Optional numbered migrations. folder = null turns the whole migration flow off.
architectureRules: Example rule: the UI layer never calls the database directly.
_modules: Areas of the product for the plan register (queue.mjs plan modules).

_review: Review signals: what a diff ADDS (code files only, never tests, comment lines or docs) lifts a reviewer in on top of the class. The built-ins auth, secret, url-from-data and html-sink lift reviewer-security. Per signal: enabled, reviewer, paths (helper path patterns) and words (regular expressions, case ignored), added to a built-in; a name of your own is a new signal, e.g. { "payments": { "reviewer": "reviewer", "words": ["\\bstripe\\.charges\\."] } }. Switching a built-in off is a weakening (doctor). ravenseat helpers shows the hit rate per signal.
_models: Model per agent (track, track-d, reviewer, reviewer-docs, a helper ...): opus, sonnet, haiku or fable. Empty = each agent file's own model (opus). A set model is printed on the start lines as model=<m> and passed to the Agent tool. Measure the effect with ravenseat cost before and after.
_prices: The list prices for the cost measurement (USD per MTok). null = the built-in table per model family (scripts/orchestrator/lib/timeCost.js PRICE_TABLE: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Fable). Override per model id or a part of it, e.g. { "opus-4-1": { "input": 15, "output": 75, "cache_read": 1.5 } }; cache_5m and cache_1h default to 1.25x and 2x the input price.
_metrics: Transcript metrics in the time log: idleGapMin = a gap longer than this many minutes between two transcript entries is idle and not counted in active_s (the active time).
_cost: The Turns and tools block in ravenseat cost: contextThresholdK = the context in thousands of tokens that a turn's cost is counted above or below (the share of cost from long contexts). A measurement only, it never stops the queue.
_history: Where the history lives (speed, not safety; off is an INFO line in doctor). rotateTimeLog: monthly (default) renames the time log to times-YYYY-MM.jsonl next to it on the first write of a new UTC month, and every reader that needs older rows reads those too; off keeps one file. archiveDoneAfterDays: done and cancelled tasks finished and untouched for this many days move from queue.json to queue-archive.json in the data folder, where info, explain, plans and statistics still find them read-only; null keeps them all in queue.json.
_triage: Intake triage: before fill starts a task added or last edited minAgeDays ago or more (null = no age rule), or one an agent added (agentAdded, once), the triage helper checks it read-only against the current code: ready, done, stale or adjust (ravenseat triage <id> --verdict ...). Never fix tasks or continuations. Off: ravenseat helpers off triage. Lite mode: off unless switched on.
_focus: When a focus has ended (every stage done, or its period is over): continueWhenEmpty false (default) pauses the queue (fill starts nothing) and asks the owner one question in Waiting on you: set a new focus or continue the regular queue. true = the queue continues by itself, with one line saying so. Per focus: ravenseat focus set ... --continue-when-empty on|off. A project that never set a focus is not affected.
_protectedPaths: Replacing or emptying this list never frees the floor: the queue config, .claude/, git hooks, CLAUDE*.md and the queue scripts. Merge guard: paths a track may only change when its task owns them (owned_files/shared_patch); otherwise merge-track stops with exit 4 (--allow-guard overrides). "folder/", "dir/file", a bare file name (any folder) or a glob with * or ? (without a slash: the file name in any folder). The default list in queueConfig.js also holds the test, lint and type configs (vitest.config.*, tsconfig*.json, pytest.ini, pyproject.toml, Cargo.toml, Makefile ...). Leave the field out for the default list; a list here REPLACES it (copy the entries you keep); [] leaves only that floor. To change the defaults without copying them, use { "add": [...], "remove": [...] }: add extends them, remove takes paths out (never the floor; doctor names each removed path, and removing one is a weakened guard that needs --i-understand --by owner).
_testWeakening: receive warns (never stops) about deleted test files, test files moved out of the test paths and added skip/focus markers in test files (.skip(, .only(, xit(, @pytest.mark.skip, #[ignore], t.Skip(, @Disabled ...): one WARN line and a Test weakening section in 00-package.md. testPaths: more test file globs; markers: more regular expressions.
_focusStop: testWeakening.focusStop: a focus marker (.only(, fit(, fdescribe() on an added line in a test file stops merge, since the other tests never ran. --allow-focus overrides (logged). false = only the warning.
_loadGuard: Load guard: next, start and fill refuse new starts (exit 7, THE MACHINE IS FULL) while free memory is below minFreeMemoryPct percent. null = off. Default 10 (off on macOS, which reports the page cache as used). ravenseat limit minFreeMemoryPct <n|off> overrides it for the queue.
_loadGuardAdaptive: Load-aware slots: above the hard limit, fill/next/start open fewer than maxConcurrent slots while free memory is below allSlotsFreeMemoryPct (default 40, off on macOS), at least minSlots (1), linear in between; the commands print why (LOAD: 2 of 5 slots: ...). CPU is optional: set both allSlotsCpuPct and minSlotsCpuPct (e.g. 60 and 95). adaptive false or QUEUE_LOAD_ADAPTIVE=off turns it off; fill --over-load skips it.
_proposals: Auto-accept of agent proposals (default off): a proposal that fits the rules is approved by the queue itself, logged and can be undone (ravenseat proposals). Never D or D+, never with waiting_on, legal/owner labels, open legal points or protected paths. ravenseat proposals auto and the board write the queue's own rules, which win.
_qa: QA evidence: tracks write EVIDENCE <type>[=<ref>] in track-result.md and receive stores it. autoTypes are closed by ravenseat qa auto --run when autoCommand is green ({refs} = the refs, {id} = the task id; a string or { type: command }). evidenceLabels = labels receive warns for when the line is missing.
_cloud: Cloud tracks (features.cloud turns them on; ravenseat cloud setup lists what they need). offerOnLeave: the orchestrator offers ravenseat cloud-go once when you say you are leaving; false keeps it silent. maxSessions: at most this many at once; they share your plan's usage limits. start: terminal (you run ravenseat cloud-start <id>) or routine (ravenseat cloud send <id> fires the scheduled task at fireUrl, without a terminal; the token only ever goes in the environment variable RAVENSEAT_CLOUD_TOKEN).
_capacity: Weekly quota reset used by queue.mjs capacity. null = default (Tuesday 19:00 local time). resetDay 0-6, 0 = Sunday.
_board: mascot: the speech bubble on the board, "chatty", "events" (only events and clicks) or "off" (no bubbles for anyone). queue-board.mjs --mascot overrides it. updateCheck: the board looks for a newer plugin version on GitHub at most once per 24 hours (a plain GET, nothing about you is sent); false turns it off. showCloud (default true): show the Cloud tab (only with features.cloud on); `ravenseat board-setting cloud on|off` sets it in queue.json, which wins. blockedColumn: a Blocked column after In queue for tasks with an open blocker that needs action (off by default); `ravenseat board-setting blocked on|off` sets it in queue.json, which wins.
_features: Modules that can be switched off or on. cloud and follow also answer "off" in the CLI; plans.* only hide parts of the board (the CLI plan register always works). Unknown keys are ignored.
